description: Household expenditure and household characteristics were used as the empirical basis for the synthetic population.
synthetic_assumption: HCES households were sampled to construct representative synthetic personal financial profiles.

description: 10,000 synthetic users were generated by sampling prepared HCES household profiles with replacement.
synthetic_assumption: A household profile is used as the spending/household characteristic basis of a representative synthetic user; it is not treated as an actual individual.

description: Monthly income was generated from monthly expenditure using financial-situation-specific expense-to-income ranges.
synthetic_assumption: Income is not directly observed in the prepared HCES profile used by the simulation.

description: Initial savings were generated using a synthetic savings-buffer duration applied to monthly expenditure.
synthetic_assumption: Savings-buffer ranges differ according to financial situation.

description: Debt presence, debt burden and EMI were generated from financial-situation-specific ranges.
synthetic_assumption: The prepared HCES profile does not provide complete individual debt and EMI information.

description: Investment participation was generated from investment capacity, savings buffer and positive surplus.
synthetic_assumption: Investment behaviour is simulated because actual individual investment holdings are unavailable.

description: Risk capacity was calculated using population-relative percentile ranks of savings buffer, investment capacity, debt burden and EMI burden.
synthetic_assumption: Equal contribution was used because there is no empirical basis in the available datasets for unequal weights.

description: Each synthetic user receives a goal horizon within the simulation horizon.
synthetic_assumption: Goal horizon is synthetically generated because actual personal goal dates are unavailable.

description: Goal target amount is generated relative to the user's annual financial scale.
synthetic_assumption: Actual individual goal target amounts are unavailable.

description: Historical inflation observations were used to construct the monthly inflation path.
synthetic_assumption: Historical annual inflation observations are sampled with replacement for the simulation timeline.

description: Historical monthly NIFTY 50 returns were used as the market scenario path.
synthetic_assumption: The historical path is used as a simulation scenario, not as a forecast.

description: Historical weighted average lending rates were aligned to the simulation timeline.
synthetic_assumption: Where later simulation months extend beyond the latest available WALR observation, the latest available value is carried forward.

description: Monthly income is dynamically adjusted using the cumulative inflation factor.
synthetic_assumption: This provides a consistent purchasing-power adjustment because individual salary-growth data is unavailable.

description: Portfolio returns are linked to the historical market return through the user's risk-capacity-based market exposure.
synthetic_assumption: Market exposure is a simulation parameter and does not represent an actual recommended asset allocation.

description: Actual goal contribution is constrained by positive monthly surplus and the user's goal allocation factor.
synthetic_assumption: The contribution represents simulated goal funding capacity rather than an observed transaction.

description: Goal success is determined by comparing funding available within the goal horizon against the target amount.
synthetic_assumption: Success represents the simulated ability to fund the goal under the modelled scenario.

description: Simulation results describe behaviour under the defined historical and synthetic assumptions.
synthetic_assumption: Results must not be interpreted as guaranteed financial returns or predictions for real individuals.
